assay_audit.scope: 2016 nine-page original PDF and all original figures/table pixels inspected. 2014 complete web-reader extracted text inspected; original pixel access failed. All arithmetic below is diagnostic, conditional where stated, and never an accepted recovery yield.

table2.blank_interpretation: Unprinted symmetric triangle, not missing experimental replicate results and not zeros. No filled-in matrix is claimed.

figures.assessment: F1/F2/F4 enzyme panels inspected as screening context. Phosphatase graph label omits h^-1 present in prose; no strain-specific in-compost causality inferred.
Nine 100% stacks are fraction variables across seven treatment series, not treatment-specific sum-to-100 P balances. Legend order T8,T4,T2,T1,T7,T3,T6 retained. No digitized fraction matrix.
Literal labels T1,T2,T6,T3,T7,T4,T8; plotted T8 bicarbonate Pi lower than T4. Prose assigns highest T8 yet lists 28.59 then29.37 for T8/T4. No relabeling.
Plotted hydroxide Po maximum at T8 under literal axis labels; prose names T6. No relabeling or exact digitization.

T8 HCl-P marker is visibly on zero while text says8.51–14.39% range. Zero versus missing/plotting error unresolved; no observation assigned. Residual fraction is subtraction-defined, not isolated mineral evidence.

methods_2016.feed: 10kg paddy straw in80L bins,6–8cm pieces; dried CM/FYM/PM15%(w/w), denominator and weighing moisture not explicit. Poultry farm nearNewDelhi; species and bedding unresolved.
methods_2016.inoculum: A.niger ITCC6719, A.flavus ITCC6720, T.harzianum ITCC6721 on wheat bran plus MgSO4/NH4NO3/NaCl; growth at27C10d, mixed1:1:1. Each culture mixed with200mL sterile water; per-bin biomass/carrier/volume unresolved. Added day25 atabout37C.
methods_2016.process: 120d aerobic composting; moisture65–70%,then60%,then50%; manual turning fortnightly. Uninoculated arms contain ambient microbiota. No matched carrier-only/killed/sterile controls established.
methods_2016.fractionation: 0.5g dry equivalent sequentially extracted with30mL water,0.5M NaHCO3(pH8.5),0.1M NaOH,1.0M HCl,16h175rpm each. Pi versus digestedTP determines Po by subtraction. ResidualP=TP−sumfractions.
methods_2016.replication: Means of three replicates stated; independent compost-bin count versus analytical replication unresolved. Original replicate ledger absent from inspected routes.
methods_2016.mass_accounting: Final dry mass, sampling-removal ledger, straw/manure/bran/inoculum P inventory, losses and matched balances unavailable in inspected2016original.
